subject: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, and event log samples request
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@medarahealth.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: security@medarahealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter + control artifacts request

Hi Logan,

We’re finalizing procurement for our upcoming integration with Redwood and need to collect your SOC 2 Type II materials and a short bridge letter that confirms controls coverage up to our expected go-live. The security review team also asked for a few control-level artifacts beyond the report to close a couple of open items: 

- A bridge letter that states the audit window (Type II period) and whether any significant control changes occurred since the report.
- A representative slice of host/network event logs (CloudTrail or syslog) covering a 24–72 hour window in March 2027 (anonymized is fine; we only need timestamped events + service/component identifiers).
- MFA rotation/change logs or an audit extract showing MFA enrollment and rotation events for administrative users during the SOC 2 period.
- The most recent access review / recertification attestation for privileged groups.
- Your completed SIG Lite or CAIQ export if available (a PDF or CSV is fine).

Can you confirm acceptance of these asks and provide an estimated delivery date? If any of the items are out of scope for customers, let us know what equivalent evidence you can supply. We’re on a tight timeline — would prefer to receive materials by EOD Wednesday 21 Apr PT.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Security Analyst
Medara Health
elena@medarahealth.com

Attachment: Medara_RFP_SecurityChecklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and the deadline. I’m looping in our security and compliance leads (Kimberly and Olga) to own the artifacts. Quick answers up front:

- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (2026 period) and a short bridge letter covering controls posture through Apr 1, 2027.
- We can provide a 48-hour event-log slice in a sanitized tarball (syslog/CloudTrail-format) — we’ll redact IPs and PII before delivery.
- MFA change/enrollment audit extracts and privileged access review attestations are available, but some extracts will be export snapshots (CSV/PDF) rather than raw DB dumps.
- We can share SIG/CAIQ export (PDF).

Kimberly/Olga — can you confirm whether the 48-hour log slice should be March 10–11 or March 15–16 (Medara asked for March 2027 broadly)? Also confirm if the access review attestation can be an internal signed PDF vs. a signed DocuSign.

Elena — if you can confirm preferred log dates and whether a signed attestation PDF is acceptable, we’ll target delivery by EOD 21 Apr PT. If anything needs escalation (legal redlines, export controls), I’ll expedite.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — thanks for the patience; attached is the initial package and a delivery plan for the other artifacts you requested. Summary below and attachments included.

What we’ve attached (initial delivery):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (official SOC 2 Type II report; redacted vendor attachments removed)
- Redwood_bridge_letter_2027-04-01.pdf (signed bridge letter confirming no material control changes since the Type II period ended 2026-12-31)

Planned supplemental artifacts (delivery schedule):
- syslog_sample_2027-03-15.tgz (48-hour anonymized event log slice) — delivery by 21 Apr 2027. The tarball will contain gzipped JSON/CLF lines with timestamps, service names, and sanitized host ids; IPs will be redacted.
- mfa_enrollment_rotation_extract_2026-2027.csv — a CSV extract of MFA enrollment/rotation events for admin/privileged accounts (no secrets). Delivery by 21 Apr 2027.
- privileged_access_review_attestation_2027-03.pdf — signed attestation of the quarterly privileged access recertification that covered the SOC 2 period. Delivery by 21 Apr 2027.
- CAIQ_export_2027.pdf — our completed CAIQ (exported PDF). Delivery by 21 Apr 2027.

Notes & clarifications:
- Log window: we prepared March 15–16, 2027 as requested; if Medara prefers a different window, we can swap but this will add ~24 hours for re-redaction.
- Format & redaction: we will not include raw IP addresses or user PII. Filenames inside the tarball map to service components, e.g., api-gateway-20270315.jsonl.gz.
- Scope exceptions: the SOC 2 report omits a small list of vendor-specific attachments (third-party pen test reports) which we cannot distribute. We’ll document those exceptions in the bridge letter.

Attachments (initial):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (application/pdf; 2.1MB)
- Redwood_bridge_letter_2027-04-01.pdf (application/pdf; 12KB)

Delivery links (for larger artifacts):
- https://drive.redwood.com/shared/medara/soc2_2026 (will contain the tarball and CSV once ready)

If you’re available this week, happy to do a 20-minute call to walk through the artifacts and confirm they meet Medara’s audit needs.

Thanks,
